verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a native integrations catalog of auditor-vetted integrations that collect compliance data automatically. Monitors check connected cloud systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP, and integrations refresh data daily or ad hoc. However, only cloud providers are named, and nothing documents the access scopes those integrations request. missing for 10: evidence of identity, HR, code-hosting, MDM and ticketing integrations; documented read-only scopes or permissions per integration; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can connect my real stack — cloud providers, identity, HR, code hosting, MDM, ticketing — through a documented integrations catalog with read-only scopes

citations.quote: Connect your business tools and apps to Thoropass via our auditor-vetted native integrations.
Monitors automatically check your connected systems (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP) for compliance with the control's requirements.
Thoropass integrations are vetted and approved by auditors. High-quality data automatically satisfies evidence requests while powering transparent continuous compliance monitors.
Monitors and integrations will be refreshing data up to daily or ad-hoc
